item.text: Lustrous Bog-moss (*Sphagnum subnitens*) is a moss in the family Sphagnaceae with an almost cosmopolitan distribution. It forms dense cushions or hummocks in wet habitats such as boggy grasslands, marshes, fens, ditches, wet woodlands, heather banks, and blanket bogs. [s1:p1–s1:p4]
